messages:
nina: quick thought  what if the timepicker had a 'snap-to-event' action so you can capture a deploy/test window and drop a slim anchor on the heatmap for instant p95 comparison across days? session by default, with 'save comparison' for links.

omar: love it. two concerns: 1) how obvious is anchor creation (keyboard+mouse), 2) sampling interaction  sampled p95 can look like regressions.

lee: sampling reality: we run reservoir sampling per bucket today, so p95 can jitter if anchors don’t align to bucket boundaries. proposal: show a tiny "Sampled" pill that shows sample_rate on hover + add an API flag anchor_mode=stream|full. streaming deltas keeps UI fast.

rachel: copy: button "Create anchor"; tooltip "Capture this window for quick comparison." also add an inline note under p95: "Results may be sampled. Click to see sample rate or run full scan."

a11y-bot: checklist: anchor creation reachable via keyboard, new anchor announced via aria-live ("Anchor created: <label>"), marker color >=4.5:1 contrast, pill has accessible name and tooltip, focus order preserved.

nina: next steps: rachel to mock copy + aria flow, lee/omar to validate API and streaming plan. 15m follow-up tomorrow. :thumbsup:
